description.en: Delegates Codex tasks from DSH conversations with live task cards, a native right-side output panel, saved CLI history, and configurable accounts and models. Also includes interactive agent-switch terminals with tab and grid layouts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中委派 Codex 子任务，显示实时任务卡片，并在原生右侧面板查看 CLI 输出与历史；可配置账号和模型，也保留支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch 交互终端。
